intro: Barbados is a parliamentary republic since 2021.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is head of state; the prime minister, Mia Mottley since 2018, leads the government. Mottley is known worldwide for her climate finance campaigning.

chapters.title: Old parliament
text: Barbados's parliament, from 1639, is one of the oldest in the Commonwealth.

keyTerms.meaning: Mottley's plan to reform climate finance.
